column1: # JLCPCB part mapping — the human-maintained source of truth for LCSC part numbers.
# The exporter matches each placed component to the FIRST row here whose
#   match_package is a PREFIX of the component's footprint name AND
#   match_value is "*" (any) or equals the component's schematic Value.
# Put specific-value rows ABOVE wildcard ("*") rows for the same package.
#   match_package footprint-name prefix to match (KiCad footprint without the "lib:" part)
#   comment       BOM "Comment" text emitted for this part (canonical
#   lcsc          LCSC part number (JLCPCB). Leave blank to force a "no part" warning.
#   jlc_class     Basic / Extended (informational; Extended parts incur a feeder fee)
#   rot_offset    degrees added to KiCad rotation for JLCPCB (default 0; VERIFY in JLC preview)

column8: op-amp; sch value blank on U1..U27 — mapped by package
